import sys, os, stat, hashlib, types
if not (sys.flags.isolated and sys.flags.no_site and sys.flags.dont_write_bytecode):
    raise SystemExit("Python -I -S -B required before local loading")
p = sys.argv[1]
if not p.startswith("/") or any(x in ("", ".", "..") for x in p[1:].split("/")):
    raise SystemExit("absolute clean source path required")
parts = p[1:].split("/")
parent = os.open("/", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
for part in parts[:-1]:
    nxt = os.open(part, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
    os.close(parent)
    parent = nxt
fd = os.open(parts[-1], os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=parent)
with os.fdopen(fd, "rb") as stream:
    before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
    if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or before.st_size != 52525:
        raise SystemExit("source regular/exact size before compile")
    raw = stream.read(52525 + 1)
    after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
current = os.stat(parts[-1], dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
os.close(parent)
stamp = lambda x: (x.st_dev, x.st_ino, x.st_mode, x.st_size, x.st_mtime_ns, x.st_ctime_ns)
if len(raw) != 52525 or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != "b3470853d6b2a74b0ce75028cde553344cf3a76a12eddcb3fb8f2e169b229a1a" or stamp(before) != stamp(after) or stamp(before) != stamp(current):
    raise SystemExit("source identity before compile")
component = types.ModuleType("verified_host_execution_component")
component.__file__ = p
exec(compile(raw, p, "exec", dont_inherit=True), component.__dict__)
